distribution: The original two external inputs and encode_hashes.txt remain unchanged in the checkout. Both legacy PBMs are excluded from Cargo packaging; only three original geometric PBMs and their generator/inventory are distributed. Default tests use the original corpus. The retained legacy byte gate is explicitly ignored by default and must be run by name with --ignored; the optional JBIG2_LEGACY_FIXTURES=1 matrix fails if old inputs are missing rather than downloading or silently replacing them. Publishing remains disabled for other source-rights review; fixture uncertainty is removed from the crate package by exclusion, not by a new rights claim.
not_included: The upstream PBM downloaded for visual comparison stays under /tmp and is not added to the package.
